service.description: The list's keep JSON carried into a task and back. Only task-find fields are returned; the screen always returns to its own List, never to a supplied URL. Missing or malformed context uses the normal list.

Whether the current user may see and change a task: found (a WetTask), visible (get#RecordLinkInfo with checkOnly), the user's current roles on it (not declined or unassigned), isOwner, isAssignee, isWatcher (the Watcher role or a RecordFollower row) and canUpdate (owner or assignee; never in a closed project or for a production run's operation, F38, which is not found in Projects; a maintenance work order and its steps are not found at all, MANAGED_WORK naming the work order to open in Maintenance, impl-maintenance P3). need: check answers without an error, view adds "not available" when it is not found or not visible, update adds an error also when the user may not change it.

parameter.name: app
parameter.description: commons, or projects: IronStone Projects' rule (design-projects.md §1.1): an item of a project the user sees (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#VisibleProjectInfo; a Restricted or Confidential one for its parties and the project's managers) is visible, besides the Commons rule; and its owner, its assignees, the project's team (a current role on the project other than a client's) and ADMIN may change it, its project's managers (and a Projects manager who sees it) manage it too (canManage).

parameter.name: isMember
parameter.description: projects: on the item's project's team

parameter.name: canManage
parameter.description: projects: a manager of the item's project

service.description: The rows of the Tasks list: the user's slice (see above) in one smart list, narrowed by the find, sorted and paged, each decorated (decorate#TaskRows), with the count of every smart list (over the slice, without the find). The smart lists: all (open, the default), today (open and due today, less what the user snoozed on Today), week (open and due from today through the next seven days), overdue (open and due before today), assigned (open, the user an Assignee), created (open, the user's party the owner), watching (open, the user a Watcher or a follower) and done (Complete or Closed, the latest first). Open is not Complete, Closed or Cancelled; due is the estimated completion date, else the estimated start. A status in the find takes the place of the list's open or done. Each row has the fields the list's board and calendar read: workEffortId (the key), workEffortName, statusId, priority, estimatedCompletionDate (the due day) and dueAllDay.

parameter.name: recordId
parameter.description: The id of a record the task is on (RequestWorkEffort, WikiPageWorkEffort or WorkEffortRecord)

parameter.name: pageNoLimit
parameter.description: Every row on one page (the Tasks calendar's dates, with dueFrom and dueThru)

service.description: Task rows as the lists show them: the link, the status (label and color), done, the due date as text with its edit value (yyyy-MM-dd), and as estimatedCompletionDate (the due day, yyyy-MM-dd, with dueAllDay Y: the Tasks calendar shows a task a whole day on it), overdue and due today, the purpose, the project, the record the task is on (its caption and link), the assignees, the estimated and remaining hours, and what the user may do (canUpdate; onToday when it is on the user's Today, canAddToToday when Add to today applies). entries holds the user's roles, snooze and follow of each task (find#TaskRows); without it they are read.

parameter.name: detailPath
parameter.description: The screen a row links to

service.description: The quick-add row: a task for the user (owner and assignee), due on dueDate (a date, yyyy-MM-dd, or with a time; none by default, today on the Today list), in the project of the find when there is one.
A project (WetProject) the user may put tasks in: one the user may see (get#RecordLinkInfo).
The projects of the project drop-downs: open WetProject work efforts the user is a party to or owns, or that are of general visibility, by name.

A status change of the task by a user who may change it (get#TaskAccess), along the task's status flow (its own, else its project's, else Default: mantle.work.TaskServices.set#TaskStatus, which refuses a move the flow has not). In Commons a task goes to In Planning, In Progress, On Hold, Complete or Cancelled and the statuses of the development flow (Approved and Closed are the Projects app's); in Projects to any status of its flow. Complete sets the resolution (resolutionEnumId, else Completed) and the actual completion date, Cancelled its resolution (else Won't Complete); going back from Complete clears them. stopRepeating Y on a recurring task ends its rule first, so cancelling it makes no next one (else a cancel skips it and the next is made).

return.message: A task in Commons cannot be set to ${toStatusId}

service.description: The done checkbox: an open task to Complete, a done one back (Complete to In Progress, Closed to In Planning, as the status flow has them).

return.message: A cancelled task is not done; open it again first

service.description: An inline edit of the list or the detail: field due (a date, yyyy-MM-dd, keeping the time of day of the old due date; empty clears it) or priority (1 to 9), by the task's owner or an assignee.
The Edit dialog of TaskDetail: name, purpose, description, priority and due date (update#TaskField), by the task's owner or an assignee; a field not given stays as it is.

Add to Today: the task shows on the user's Today. The snooze on the user's rows is cleared (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.snooze#UserTodayItem unsnooze), and a task with no due date or due after today is made due today, keeping the time of day of its due date (which only its owner or an assignee may change). The user must be on the task, as Today shows only those.

return.message: Today has the tasks you are on: assign this one to yourself first

service.description: The task to another assignee (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.replace#WorkEffortParty, role Assignee, status Assigned): the current assignees end, the new one is added; by the owner or an assignee.

return.message: ${assignToPartyId} is not someone a task can be assigned to

set.from: ec.resource.expand('${name} is assigned to ${assignee}', '', {name:(access.workEffort.workEffortName || workEffortId), assignee:assigneeName})

service.description: A bulk action of the Tasks list on the selected tasks (workEffortIds, a list or comma-separated text): complete, reassign (assignToPartyId), setDue (dueDate, yyyy-MM-dd; empty clears), setPriority (priority) or moveToProject (rootWorkEffortId; empty takes the tasks out of their project). Each task on its own transaction: one the user may not change, or whose change fails, is logged and counted in failedCount with its reason in failures, and the others go on.
The people a task or request can be assigned to: active users with a party (ironstone.shared.ChatterServices search#Users) as drop-down options, value the party.

What TaskDetail shows of a task the user may see (found false, or visible false: "not available"): the task decorated as a list row, its description, what its status-bar shows (statusFlowId, the stages In Planning, In Progress and Complete, and allowedStatusIds, the statuses the user may move it to), purpose, project and parent, the owner, the assignees and watchers, the records it is on, the sub-tasks (decorated), the user's time entries on it with the open one, the totals, and the actions that apply: canUpdate (owner or assignee), canDelete (the owner, with no time logged and no sub-tasks), and the add to today of the row.

parameter.name: app
parameter.description: commons or projects (get#TaskAccess): in projects the status-bar has the stages of the item's flow and every move of it, and the owner or a manager of the project may delete it

parameter.name: detailPath
parameter.description: The screen the links to a task go to

service.description: A sub-task of the task (parentWorkEffortId, the same project), for the user, due on dueDate; by the task's owner or an assignee.

A copy of the task for the user (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.clone#WorkEffort): In Planning, the same name with "(copy)", description, purpose, priority, due date, estimate, project and parent, with its files and notes but no time, no actual dates and no parties; the user's party owns it and is its assignee; on the same records.

service-call.name: mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.clone#WorkEffort
service-call.in-map: {baseWorkEffortId:workEffortId, workEffortName:cloneName, statusId:'WeInPlanning', resolutionEnumId:'WerUnresolved', clearDates:true, estimatedStartDate:base.estimatedStartDate, estimatedCompletionDate:base.estimatedCompletionDate, ownerPartyId:ec.user.userAccount?.partyId, actualWorkTime:0, remainingWorkTime:base.estimatedWorkTime, actualCost:0, actualClientCost:0, copyParty:false, copyAssetAssign:false}

service.description: Convert to request: a draft request filed by the user with the task's name, description and priority (mantle.request.RequestServices.create#Request), its customer the party the task is on when it is on one, linked to the task by RequestWorkEffort. The task stays as it is; the request opens to be completed and submitted.

set.from: ec.resource.expand('Request ${requestId} drafted from the task; submit it when it is ready', '', {requestId:requestId})

service.description: Delete own: a task the user created (owns) with no time logged, no sub-tasks, no comments and no files (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.delete#WorkEffort with its parties, after its record links and followers, which are links only). Anything else is refused: cancel the task instead.

return.message: Only the task's owner may delete it; cancel it instead

service.description: Clock in on the task: the user's timer starts on it from now (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.start#Timer: one runs per person, so a timer on another item stops first; the week must not be submitted), for one who may update it, with no timer already on it.

return.message: You are already clocked in on this task

set.from: clockOut.stoppedTimeEntryIds?.length ? ec.resource.expand('Clocked in at ${time}; the timer on the other item stopped', '', {time:ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'h:mm a')}) : ec.resource.expand('Clocked in at ${time}', '', {time:ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'h:mm a')})

service.description: Clock out: the user's timer on the task stops now (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.stop#Timer: store#TimeEntry counts the hours and the rates and lowers the remaining time; under a minute it is discarded).

return.message: You are not clocked in on this task

service.description: Add time: hours on a day (fromDate, by default now less the hours) with a comment, for an owner or assignee (mantle.work.TaskServices.add#TaskTime).

return.message: Hours are more than 0 and at most 24

service.description: Removes one of the user's own time entries on the task that is not invoiced (mantle.work.TimeServices delete#TimeEntry).

if.condition: entry == null || entry.workEffortId != workEffortId || entry.partyId != ec.user.userAccount?.partyId

return.message: Time entry ${timeEntryId} is not yours on this task
